scripts.framework:dev: npm run build:legacy && npm run dev --workspace @sgs/site
scripts.framework:build: npm run build:legacy && npm run build --workspace @sgs/site && npm run framework:postbuild-routes && npm run framework:harden-dist
scripts.framework:preview: npm run framework:build && npm run preview --workspace @sgs/site
scripts.validate: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build
scripts.serve: npm run framework:build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting
scripts.deploy: npm run framework:build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.preview: npm run framework:build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview
